CXMT (SHSE:688825)

Overview: CXMT manufactures DRAM memory chips such as DDR4, DDR5 and LPDDR variants for servers, PCs, mobiles and smart cars, along with additional foundry and R&D services.

Market Cap: CN¥2,505.6b

CXMT is directly exposed to the Anthropic and AI infrastructure segment because every GPU cluster and cloud server requires large amounts of DRAM. Recent nine month 2026 results showed CN¥269,024.11 million in revenue and CN¥132,040.05 million in net income, providing concrete figures for that AI memory angle. Delta Electronics (Thailand) (SET:DELTA)

Overview: Delta Electronics (Thailand) supplies power and thermal hardware for servers, data centers and EVs, plus broader automation and energy solutions.

Operations: The business is heavily weighted to Power Electronics at THB186,591 million. Infrastructure and Mobility contribute THB43,461 million and THB23,377 million respectively.

That pricing tension is exactly what the full narrative for Delta Electronics (Thailand) unpacks, showing how Delta Electronics (Thailand) could balance AI demand, capital intensity and margin risk.

Murata Manufacturing (TSE:6981)

Overview: Murata Manufacturing produces ceramic-based capacitors, inductors, sensors, batteries and wireless modules that underpin smartphones, vehicles and data center hardware worldwide.

Operations: Murata Manufacturing generates ¥1.35t from Components and ¥667.1b from Devices and Modules, with a smaller ¥70.5b contribution from Others.
